tieu_de: QC Engineer API, SQL, Automation Testing
mo_ta_cong_viec:
DatVietVAC Group Holdings is looking for a QC Engineer to ensure the quality of our Fan Commerce Platform across web and mobile applications.
This role focuses on the accuracy and reliability of critical transactional flows, including payments, inventory, cancellations, refunds, and reconciliation. You will perform functional, API, integration, database, and exploratory testing while gradually building automated tests for core platform workflows.1. Test Planning and Test Design
Analyze product requirements, business rules, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Develop test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test procedures for product features and releases.
Design comprehensive test scenarios for high-risk transactional workflows, including payments, inventory, reservations, orders, promotions, cancellations, refunds, and reconciliation.
Identify functional, integration, data-integrity, performance, and security risks.
Build and maintain regression test suites for the platform’s core user journeys.
Prepare appropriate test data for web, mobile, API, integration, and database testing.
Clarify unclear requirements and identify missing or conflicting business rules before development and release.2. Functional, API, and Integration Testing
Perform functional testing across web and mobile applications.
Test REST and gRPC APIs and validate request, response, authentication, authorization, and error-handling behaviors.
Test integrations with payment gateways, third-party services, and connected systems.
Use SQL queries to validate data accuracy, consistency, and integrity at the database level.
Verify end-to-end transactional flows across frontend, mobile, backend, database, and third-party systems.
Perform ad hoc, exploratory, negative, boundary-value, and edge-case testing.
Validate transaction status, payment results, inventory changes, refunds, cancellations, and reconciliation data.
Conduct regression testing before product releases and major events.
Collaborate with the SRE team on performance and load testing before high-traffic on-sale periods.3. Defect Management and Quality Reporting
Document defects clearly with reproducible steps, supporting evidence, expected results, actual results, severity, and priority.
Track defects throughout their lifecycle and ensure that issues are properly resolved and verified.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Backend Engineers, Frontend and Mobile Engineers, and SRE/DevOps Engineers to investigate issues and identify root causes.
Verify bug fixes and assess their potential impact on related product areas.
Prepare test execution reports, defect reports, and release-quality assessments.
Communicate product-quality risks and release concerns clearly to relevant stakeholders.
Support internal teams in investigating product incidents and production issues.4. Test Automation and Process Improvement
Gradually develop automated tests for APIs and critical transactional workflows.
Maintain and improve automated regression test suites.
Integrate automated tests into the CI pipeline where appropriate.
Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, pytest, k6, JMeter, or equivalent testing solutions.
Support performance, load, and basic security testing activities.
Identify repetitive testing tasks that can be automated to improve release efficiency.
Propose improvements to testing processes, defect prevention, test coverage, and overall product quality.
Contribute to shared testing standards, documentation, and quality best practices.

Proficiency in API testing using Postman, REST Client, or equivalent tools.

Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset.
Critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.

Strong collaboration skills when working with Product, Engineering, and SRE/DevOps teams.
Data-driven thinking and good analytical ability.
Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
Willingness to learn and continuously improve testing and automation capabilities.
Ability to work effectively under pressure during product releases and live events.Language Skills
